list.text: I work with Professor Oak.

then.text: Professor Oak is in the Pokémon Lab in the Cinnabar Island right now.
He's expecting to see you there.

list.text: A Pokédex to give for beginner Trainers.
\f[faceprofcarvalho]\bHi \PN!\nI was waiting for you!
\f[faceprofcarvalho]\bDuring your matches in the World Cup, I could see your raw talent.\nBut I noticed you're still not able to Mega Evolve your Pokemon.
\f[faceprofcarvalho]\bAnd Mega Evolution is exactly what I'm researching right now, so both of us could benefit from that research!
\f[faceprofcarvalho]\bTo get you started, I have these 3 Pokemon that can Mega Evolve, and I would like for you to pick one of them.
\f[faceprofcarvalho]\bIt's very important for the research to have him on your party, so we can observe him grow and then Mega Evolve.

then.text: \f[faceprofcarvalho]\bYou seem to have no room on your party...\nPlease deposit a Pokemon so you can pick the new one.

list.text: \f[faceprofcarvalho]\bIt's seems like not all Pokemon are capable of Mega Evolving, some sort of special bond with his Trainer is needed to achieve that.
\f[faceprofcarvalho]\bHowever, I'm sure you will make an honest attempt on our behalf!
\f[faceprofcarvalho]\bChoose your new Pokemon wisely.

lines: Is on left side of the table
Is on right side of the table

list.text: \f[faceprofcarvalho]\bThat's an interesting choice!\nHope you can become good friends!
\f[faceprofcarvalho]\bYou'll have to develop a real bond with him so he can Mega Evolve.\nTo do that I think you should take the Kanto Gym challenge.
\f[faceprofcarvalho]\bI'm sure it'll be a big challenge, even for you!
\f[faceprofcarvalho]\bOh!\nJust one more thing...\nLet me see your Pokedex.
\f[faceprofcarvalho]\bI'll upgrade your Pokedex with the Kanto mode.
\PN Pokedex was updated with the Kanto mode.
\f[faceprofcarvalho]\bIn each region you'll find different Pokemon, with that mode you'll be able help us gather more information about the Pokemon in Kanto region.
\f[faceprofcarvalho]\bLot's of things going on!\nSorry to bother you with all that.
\f[faceprofcarvalho]\bMaybe Red just got lost in the Viridian Forest once again...
\f[faceprofcarvalho]\bHow is the Pokémon I gave you going?
\f[faceprofcarvalho]\bIt's important that you train it well to help on our Mega Evolution research.

\f[faceprofcarvalho]\bHey, calm down Pika!
\f[faceprofcarvalho]\bWhat you're doing here?\nWhere's Red?!
\f[faceprofcarvalho]\bHe's trying to say something...
\f[faceyellow]\rCalm down Pika, I know you're worried about Red, but we need to stay calm.\nI'm sure he will be fine!
\f[faceprofcarvalho]\bHi Yellow! What's going on?
\f[faceyellow]\rRed's missing since he won the Wold Cup, do you have any news about him?
\f[faceprofcarvalho]\bNo, I didn't hear from him since the World Cup too...\nBut it's not unusual for him to do that, so I was not even worried.
\f[faceyellow]\rThis time things seems more serious!\nPika told me something about Red's being hypnotized and then disappearing in the dark!
\f[faceyellow]\rAll Pika could do was run away and look for help.
\f[faceyellow]\rBut now we don't know where he is...\nWe need to keep searching!
\f[faceyellow]\rHey, you know who Red is, right?!
\f[faceyellow]\rIf you get any information about him, please give me a call.
\f[faceyellow]\rLet's go find him Pika!
\f[faceprofcarvalho]\bI'm worried about that...
\f[faceprofcarvalho]\bMaybe he just got lost in the Viridian Forest once again...\nCan you go there to check for me?
